title: General.
officialText: Where the protection and/or support of a structure or property adjacent to an excavation is required, an engineer shall prepare a preconstruction report summarizing the condition of the structure or property. The preconstruction report shall be prepared based on an examination of the structure or property, the review of available documents and, if necessary, the excavation of test pits. The engineer shall determine the requirements for underpinning or other protection and prepare site and structure-specific plans, including details and sequence of work for submission to the commissioner. Such protection may be provided by underpinning, sheeting, and bracing, or by other means acceptable to the commissioner.
